messages:
Maya: FYI - nightly harness found 3 candidate kernels with diverging perf across archs. AVX512 machines dipped ~30% for seq=64 compared to AVX2. Link to job: https://ci.redwood/workflows/6789 (artifacts below)
ci-bot: nightly-kernel-harness finished. status: partial-fail. artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/nightly/1846201123/
Ryan: Can you paste the microbench output? curious if it's a kernel selection regression or a measurement fluke
Maya: pasted snippet from the harness logs:
```
arch=avx2 seqlen=64 kernel=matmul_fused throughput=1120 tokens/s p50=0.9ms
arch=avx512 seqlen=64 kernel=matmul_vec    throughput=785  tokens/s p50=1.3ms
arch=amx seqlen=64   kernel=matmul_amx    throughput=1400 tokens/s p50=0.7ms
```
Samir: interesting — avx512 path picked matmul_vec which is faster at long seqs but we likely mis-ranked it for short/hotloop due to cache spill behavior
Lucy: also saw KV cache thrash in the main harness traces when we switched batching heuristics; KV hits dropped from 98% -> 88% with the new batching window
Anika: that KV hit drop could explain higher p50 on avx512 if it increases memory pressure + TLB churn
Ryan: proposal: make autotuner store per-arch, per-seqlen candidate rankings + a stability score, then prefer kernels that are stable under KV pressure
Maya: +1. We should also add a microbench that reproduces the KV cache eviction pattern (mix of long/short prefixes) so CI can catch it
Samir: quick config suggestion to try before full rewrite:
```
runtime.autotune {
  prefer_stable=true
  kv_pressure_threshold=0.15
  seqlen_buckets=[16,32,64,128,256]
}
```
Lucy: for perf CI, let's set acceptance gates by relative median throughput and p99 tail; e.g. candidate must be within -8% median AND not increase p99 by >10% vs baseline
Anika: I can add a nightly sweep that runs the new KV-mixed microbench across all archs and uploads JSON diffs to s3. assigning to me for the PR :point_right: @Anika
Maya: thanks. Can you also include the kernel selection table (csv) per-arch so we can audit picks? Put under s3://redwood-perf/nightly/1846201123/selection-table.csv
ci-bot: created issue #INF-893 in backlog: "Investigate avx512 kernel regressions in nightly harness". Assigned to eng-runtime
Ryan: action items — 1) Anika to add microbench + CI job 2) Samir to prototype prefer_stable knob 3) Maya/Lucy to triage KV traces and upload filtered flamegraphs
Anika: started a draft branch: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4523 with the harness changes. will notify when runnable in CI
Maya: digging into the exact trace now, will paste flamegraphs here when ready
Ryan: thanks everyone. If the nightly sweep flakiness persists we should add an experimental per-candidate rollback in the serving runtime (hold risky picks behind a canary)
Lucy: noted. I'll also add a short-term alert rule in console: when KV hit rate drops >5% concurrent with throughput drop -> page oncall
Maya: done for now, will follow up after the next nightly run :thumbsup:
